market_outlook.short_term: Cautious. Fed hike odds rising into Sept 16 create near-term headwind; oil volatility from Mideast adds noise. VIX complacency is the key risk. Expect choppy, range-bound equities with sector rotation favoring energy and short-duration. CPI data this week is critical. 36-year history suggests initial dip on hike, then recovery if data supports.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive but uneven. AI capex cycle (Dell, Nvidia, SK hynix, Google) provides structural growth. EM rotation continues. However, US fiscal trajectory and hyperscaler bond crowding create medium-term yield risk. Copper and commodity supercycle supports inflation-linked assets. Consumer fragility (Gap, Bathla, JLR) suggests selectivity required.
